column1: I'm sorry, sir, but Departmental Policy dictates all custody arrests shall be restrained by proper handcuffing procedure, and that means 'behind your back.'
column2: 「抱歉，先生，但警局規定所有拘捕都必須依正確程序上銬，也就是『銬在背後』。」

column1: Officer Jack Cobb arrives on the scene. Cobb radios Dispatch, %m5
column2: Jack Cobb 警員抵達現場。Cobb 用無線電呼叫調度，%m5

column1: Dispatch, be advised. Hold all radio traffic until Code-4 confirmed.
column2: 「調度請注意。在確認 Code-4 前暫停所有無線電通訊。」

column1: 83-32, this is 83-31. Sonny! I'll cover you from the passenger side of your patrol car while you make contact with the suspect.
column2: 「83-32，這裡是 83-31。Sonny！你接觸嫌犯時，我會在巡邏車乘客側掩護你。」

column1: While some may applaud your exercise in street justice, democratic societies have no place for "trigger happy" cops. Sorry, Sonny.
column2: 有些人或許會讚賞你的街頭正義，但民主社會容不下「動不動就開槍」的警察。抱歉，Sonny。

column1: Jack says, "I've got him covered, Sonny. Go ahead and 'cuff him."
column2: Jack 說：「我掩護著他，Sonny。上前把他銬起來。」

column1: You order the suspect into your patrol car. He submits with a sarcastic, "All right, &!#$%&."
column2: 你命令嫌犯上巡邏車。他諷刺地服從：「好啦，&!#$%&。」

column1: Good job, Sonny! says Jack. "I'll call Dispatch and put out a Code-4."
column2: Jack 說：「做得好，Sonny！我會呼叫調度，發出 Code-4。」

column1: You must be in your car or have a radio extender.
column2: 你必須人在車內，或攜帶無線電延伸器。

column1: Dispatch, this is 83-32, you radio. "Run VIN C03456218 through the computer."
column2: 你用無線電說：「調度，這裡是 83-32。請查詢車身識別碼 C03456218。」

column1: You radio, "Dispatch, this is 83-32. Request wants on license plate 'UL6942.'"
column2: 你用無線電說：「調度，這裡是 83-32。請查詢車牌『UL6942』是否有通緝。」

column1: Quiet down, you order him. "Hey, Jack," you yell to your backup, "how's about booking this evidence?"
column2: 你命令他：「安靜。」接著向支援你的 Jack 喊道：「嘿，Jack，把這些證物登記入庫如何？」

column1: Attempting to apprehend the suspect single-handedly was brave but fatal. Review the "Felony Stop Procedures" section of your "LPD Policeman's Indoctrination Guide."
column2: 單獨逮捕嫌犯雖然勇敢，卻是致命的。請複習《LPD 警員訓練指南》的「重罪攔查程序」章節。

column1: You key your radio, "83-32, backup has arrived."
column2: 你按下無線電：「83-32，支援已抵達。」

column1: You nervously key your radio, "Dispatch, this is 83-32. Request backup Code-3!"
column2: 你緊張地按下無線電：「調度，這裡是 83-32。請求 Code-3 支援！」

column1: Jack speaks, in a very depressed voice, "Oh, Sonny! I just discovered my daughter is doing drugs! It's really screwed me up!"
column2: Jack 用非常沮喪的聲音說：「噢，Sonny！我剛發現女兒在吸毒！這真的讓我大受打擊！」

column1: Sonny, I really do appreciate you nailing that filthy scum bag pusher, but I'm afraid it might be too late.
column2: 「Sonny，我真的很感激你抓到那個骯髒的毒販，但恐怕可能已經太遲了。」

column1: My daughter, Kathy, is in the Intensive Care Ward over at Lytton General Hospital! he explains. "She's in a coma from a drug OD! There's nothing I can do!"
column2: 他解釋：「我女兒 Kathy 在 Lytton 綜合醫院的加護病房！她因吸毒過量陷入昏迷！我什麼也做不了！」

column1: Morgan wants to see you back in his office, ASAP!
column2: Morgan 要你立刻回他辦公室！

column1: Trying to cheer Jack, you tell him about the Victor Simms arrest and how he was responsible for selling dope at the high school.
column2: 你想安慰 Jack，告訴他 Victor Simms 被捕，以及他在高中販毒的事。

column1: Welcome to the Narcotics Division, Sonny, says Laura. "I'm pleased you were selected for the position."
column2: Laura 說：「歡迎來到緝毒組，Sonny。我很高興你獲選這個職位。」

column1: By the way, our radio call number is 83-Nora-10.
column2: 「順帶一提，我們的無線電呼號是 83-Nora-10。」

column1: This will be your desk, Laura continues. "Since you have your own desk now, your pigeonhole will be assigned to someone else."
column2: Laura 繼續說：「這會是你的辦公桌。既然你現在有自己的桌子，原本的信箱就會分配給別人。」
